topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 58 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 17 ERC20 tokens, 3 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 9 common project-authored base contract(s) (debttokenbase, incentivizederc20, versionedinitializable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
